officialText:
Section 210.50 – Revise the Informational Note in Section 210.50 to read as follows:

Informational Note: See Informative Annex J for information regarding ADA accessibility design. See requirements in ICC A117.1 as referenced in the New York City Building Code for information regarding the mounting height for the operable parts for dwelling units that are classified as accessible units.
